hints.tr: Doğru başlık: `{"Authorization": "Bearer " + TOKEN}`; `Bearer`'dan sonra bir boşluk var.
hints.en: The right header: `{"Authorization": "Bearer " + TOKEN}`; there is a space after `Bearer`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
import requests

BASE = "http://api.odyssey.test"
TOKEN = "letmein"

r = requests.get(BASE + "/me", headers={"Authorization": TOKEN})
print("no prefix:", r.status_code)

r = requests.get(BASE + "/me", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + TOKEN})
me = r.json()
print("with Bearer:", r.status_code)
print("user:", me["user"])
print("role:", me["role"])
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
import requests

BASE = "http://api.odyssey.test"
TOKEN = "letmein"

r = requests.get(BASE + "/me", headers={"Authorization": TOKEN})
print("no prefix:", r.status_code)

r = requests.get(BASE + "/me", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + TOKEN})
me = r.json()
print("with Bearer:", r.status_code)
print("user:", me["user"])
print("role:", me["role"])
```

hint.en: You were asked to send the token without the prefix first.
